title: Practica: AI for the green digital transition
intro: Seven quick questions. There are no wrong answers before the talk: we only want to see what changes by the end.

questions.q: In this talk, what does the green digital transition mean?
options: Moving all training online and closing workshops
Using digital tools, including AI, to build the skills and systems a low-carbon economy needs
questions.why: It is about people and skills as much as technology: digital tools and AI help train the workers a greener economy runs on.

questions.q: Why are many green jobs, like solar installation and safe wiring, hard to train for at scale?
options: They only need theory from books
They are learned by doing, with a trainer beside you, and trainers and workshop seats are limited
They can only be learned abroad
questions.why: Hands-on skills need practice and feedback. Practica brings a coach to every learner so the scarce trainers and workshops go further.

questions.q: A learner asks the Practica coach where something is in a lesson. What can the coach do?
options: Point to the exact place on the learner's screen, and open or scroll to it
questions.why: The coach knows its tools: it can point at the page, open lessons and scroll, as well as talk and listen.

questions.q: Who decides whether a learner is competent in a practical?
questions.why: The AI never grades. It helps learners practise and collect evidence; a qualified assessor makes the competence decision.

questions.q: A learner with low vision wants to study a lesson. Which Practica feature helps most?
options: The lesson podcast and narrated slides
questions.why: Every lesson can become a two-voice podcast and narrated slides, so learners can listen instead of read. Captions follow the voice for learners who are Deaf or hard of hearing.

questions.q: What does the Practica coach know about a learner?
options: Only what the learner chooses to share, which they can see word for word and switch off
questions.why: Learners control it: learning data can be switched off, personal details are off until switched on, and they can see exactly what the coach is given.

questions.q: Which choice makes an AI learning tool greener and cheaper for learners in Kenya?
options: Streaming high-definition video for every lesson
Sending every camera frame to a distant cloud data centre
Running AI on the phone and on local servers, and letting learners save lessons to use offline
Requiring a laptop and fast broadband
questions.why: On-device AI, local models and offline saving cut data, energy and cost, and keep learners' data in Kenya.
